title: A check on System message wording still fails on changes that do not touch any wording

regression.report: The narrowing fix merged, but four refactors were flagged after it

whatHappens: A refactor that changes no System wording fails the wording guard, and the agent must update the lock or rework the change.

fixes.text: Cache the guard's source analysis (#3148); speed only, not a fix for false failures

observations.text: Feedback: 6 reports from 2 agents, 10-30 15:46 to 10-31 06:35 UTC; one after the 06:33 deploy. Moving code or adding a call changes the fingerprint with no wording change.
